D/ L SEPT [SEV] PART AVG IMP X ; R/ [ANNON]AE AVGG

A silver roman denarius of Septimius Severus (r.193-211) Reece period 10. Minted at Rome 198-201AD. RIC IV, Pt I, p. 103, no. 107. Description: Obv.: Bearded laureatte bust right. Obv. legend: 'L SEPT [SEV] PART AVG IMP X'. Rev.: Annona standing left with corn ears and cornucopia, right foot on prow of galley. Rev. legend:'[ANNON]AE AVGG'. Measurements: 17.22mm in diameter, 2.2mm thick and 1.98g…
